DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今何してる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 休憩中だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 呼吸、かな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なんだそれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何もしてないってことか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: せっかく海まで来たんだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海でしか出来ないことをしないと、もったいないぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 海でしか出来ないこと……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 泳ぐとか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 泳ぐだけなら、プールでも良いだろう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: つまりだな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海産物を獲りに行くんだ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、ちょっといいか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっき、面白い物を見つけたんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これがあれば、今度こそ先生に魚を獲ってこれる！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 倉庫に網でもあったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふん

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただの網だと思ったら間違いだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これは直接見せた方がいいな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前の波止場に来てくれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度こそ、先生に最高級の刺身を食べさせてやる！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの後、波止場の様子を見に行ったら

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水面に小魚が何匹か浮かんでいたぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おそらく、爆破の衝撃で気を失ったんだろう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 小さな魚は、意外と衝撃に弱いって聞くよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: と、いうことは……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 高圧電流を流せば、まとめて気絶……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それは絶対にダメ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、村の西側に干潟があるらしいぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 住民に聞いたら、1日に2回潮が引いて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 干潟が現れるんだとか

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 不思議な現象だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 潮が引くと、貝や魚が簡単に拾えるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……実は、海産物を獲る許可をもらった時に

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 干潟にも入っていいと言われてるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで、時間があるなら一緒に行かないか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水中では失態を見せたが、干潟で落ちてる魚を拾うだけだ。同じ過ちは繰り返さない……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度こそ、先生に最高級の海産物を食べてもらう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 結局、先生に美味しい海産物を食べてもらう作戦は失敗したな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 高級魚を獲って日頃のお礼ができると思ったんだが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いろいろ食べさせてもらったよ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 海藻スープとか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ユムシとか……?

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: たしかに美味しかったけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どれも市場で買える食材だし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生には、あれだけ付き合ってもらったのに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: サキと一緒に食べるご飯が、一番美味しいよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: からかってるのか本心なのか分かりづらいからやめてくれ……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 지금 뭐 하고 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 숨 쉬어

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그냥 쉬고 있어

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그게 뭐야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무것도 안 하고 있다는 뜻이잖아. 장난치지 마.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 모처럼 바다에 왔는데 시간이 아깝지도 않은 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 바다에 왔으니 여기서만 할 수 있는 일을 해야지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 바다에서만 할 수 있는 일이라고 해도……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 해수욕이라도 하자고?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 바다에서만 할 수 있는 일이라면 따로 있잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 바로……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 해산물 채취지!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 지금 시간 괜찮아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 방금 끝내주는 물건을 찾은 참이거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이것만 있으면 어떤 큰 물고기라도 한 방에 해치울 수 있어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 좋은 그물이라도 찾은 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그물?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 물건의 가치는 그런 평범한 어구에 비할 바가 아니라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 모모톡으로 설명하는 것보다는 직접 보여주는 게 낫겠지

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지금 바로 전의 부둣가로 와줄래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번에야말로 선생님에게 최고급 생선회를 대접할 테니까!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나중에 다시 그 부둣가에 갔다가 발견했는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 수면 위에 작은 물고기 여러 마리가 떠 있더라고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아마 아까 터트린 폭뢰의 강한 충격으로 인해 기절한 모양이야

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 작은 물고기들은 외부 충격에 약하다고 하니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……그렇다면

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자동차 배터리 같은 것으로 물에 전류를 흘려 물고기를 기절시킨다면

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그건 절대로 안 돼!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 마을 서쪽에 갯벌이 있는 거 알고 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 마을 주민들에게 들었는데, 마을의 서쪽 해안은 하루에 두 번씩 물이 빠져서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 갯벌 바닥이 드러난다고 하더라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그거 신기하네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응. 그래서 갯벌이 드러났을 때는 조개나 물웅덩이에 남아 있는 물고기를 편하게 주울 수 있대.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……사실 지난번에 마을 주민들에게 채취 허가를 받으면서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 갯벌에 들어가도 좋다는 허락도 받았거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말인데, 시간 있으면 마을 서편의 갯바위 앞으로 나와 줄래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 물 속이라면 몰라도 땅 위에서 물고기를 줍는데, 지난번 같은 실수를 저지르지는 않겠지……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번에야말로 선생님에게 최고급 해산물을 대접할 테니까!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 결국 선생님에게 진귀한 해산물 요리를 대접하는 건 실패했네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 모처럼 어촌 마을에 왔으니 비싼 물고기를 잡아 평소의 답례를 할 수 있을 거라고 생각했는데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 진귀한 해산물 요리라면 충분히 먹었는걸?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 개불회라든가……?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 해초국이라든가……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 확실히 맛은 있긴 했지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 대부분이 시장에서 구할 수 있는 평범한 해산물이었잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오히려 선생님이 어울려 준 시간을 생각하면 대단찮은 것뿐이었는데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 사키가 노력하는 모습을 지켜보며 먹는 밥이 내게는 최고의 미식이니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가끔씩 선생님이 하는 말은

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 좋은 말인지 놀리는 건지 분간하기가 어렵단 말이야……

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, what are you doing right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Breathing...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Taking it easy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What kind of answer is that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It sounds like you're not doing anything.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We're visiting the sea. Do you plan to waste the whole trip?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Since we're at the beach, we should be doing beach activities.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Beach activities, huh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Like swimming?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No, I don't mean playing or goofing off.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Catching seafood!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, are you busy right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I just happened on something amazing!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: With this, I'll be able to catch even the biggest fish!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Did you find a fishing net?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: A net?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's nothing so mundane as a net.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can't describe it here. You need to see it for yourself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Can you come to the dock right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm going to treat you to the best sashimi after this!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I went back to the dock later and found

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: little fish floating on the surface.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They must have been knocked unconscious by the explosion I set off earlier.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Small fish must be vulnerable to external shocks.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So that means...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I could rig a car battery to run currents through the water and stun the fish!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You can't do that!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you know that there is a mudflat west of town?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: According to the locals, the water recedes twice a day at the western shore

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: and exposes a mudflat!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's amazing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: All these fish get trapped in the pools that form when the tide is out, and they're easy picking.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Last time, when I asked if I could fish off their shore,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: they also said I could use the mudflat.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you have time, can you meet me at the shore on the west of town?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I won't have to actually get into the water this time, so I'm sure I won't repeat any of my old mistakes...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This time, I'm really going to catch something special for you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In the end, I didn't catch you anything good...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought I'd definitely be able to treat you to a high-class seafood meal...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I've had plenty of delicious seafood thanks to you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I got to try fat innkeeper worm...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: And seaweed soup...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They were good, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They weren't anything you couldn't get at the market.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: After all the time you wasted with me, you should have gotten something better...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Saki, knowing how hard you worked made everything taste even better.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sometimes you say these things, Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And I can't tell if you're being nice or if you're teasing me...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทำอะไรอยู่เหรอ คุณครู?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หายใจทิ้งอยู่น่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นอนแช่อยู่บนโซฟาอยู่น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หมายถึงอะไรน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หมายความว่าไม่ได้ทำอะไรอยู่นี่นา
อย่ามาล้อเล่นกันสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อุตส่าห์ได้มาทะเลทั้งที ไม่เสียดาย
เวลาบ้างรึไง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไหนๆ ก็มาถึงทะเลแล้ว ก็ควรทำ
สิ่งที่ทำได้แค่ที่ทะเลสักหน่อยสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สิ่งที่ทำได้แค่ที่ทะเล อืม...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะชวนครูไปว่ายน้ำเล่นใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เปล่าซะหน่อย ถ้าเรื่องที่ทำได้แค่ที่
ทะเลละก็ มันมีอย่างอื่นอยู่อีกนี่นา?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: นั่นก็คือ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หาอาหารทะเลไงล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ตอนนี้ว่างหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เมื่อกี้นี้ฉันเจอของที่สุดยอดมากๆ
มาด้วยแหละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอแค่มีเจ้านี่ ต่อให้ปลาตัวใหญ่แค่ไหน
ก็จับได้ในครั้งเดียวแน่นอน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เจอตาข่ายดีๆ มารึไง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตาข่ายเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เอาอุปกรณ์พื้นๆ แบบนั้นมาเทียบกับ
ของล้ำค่าแบบนี้ได้ยังไง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คิดแล้วเชียวว่าอธิบายทาง MOMOTALK
คงไม่เห็นภาพ เอาไปให้ดูเองเลย
น่าจะดีกว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นตอนนี้ช่วยมาที่ท่าเรือหน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันจะเลี้ยงปลาดิบสุดหรูคุณครูเอง!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันกลับไปที่ท่าเรือแล้วก็เห็นว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มีปลาเล็กๆ หลายตัวลอยอยู่บน
ผิวน้ำด้วยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ดูเหมือนพวกมันจะตกใจจากแรงระเบิด
เมื่อกี้จนน็อกไปแล้วน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
พวกปลาตัวเล็กๆ ไวต่อแรงสั่นสะเทือน
ภายนอกน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นถ้าเราใช้แบตเตอรี่รถยนต์มาต่อระบบ
ไฟฟ้าแล้วช็อตปลาในน้ำละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำแบบนั้นไม่ได้เด็ดขาด!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู รู้รึเปล่าว่าทางตะวันตกของ
หมู่บ้านมีหาดโคลนอยู่ด้วยน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันได้ยินมาจากพวกชาวบ้านอีกทีว่า
ชายหาดฝั่งตะวันตกน่ะ น้ำจะลงวันละ
สองครั้ง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เลยทำให้เห็นหาดโคลนน่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: น่าสนใจดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อื้อ ตอนที่น้ำลงก็จะเหลือพวกแอ่งน้ำ
เล็กๆ ที่มีปลาหรือพวกหอยอยู่ ทำให้
จับปลาได้ง่ายด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
...อันที่จริง ตอนครั้งก่อนฉันไปขออนุญาต
จากชาวเมือง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พวกเขาอนุญาตให้ไปที่หาดโคลน
ได้ด้วยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะงั้นถ้าคุณครูมีเวลาละก็ ช่วยมา
ที่แถวๆ หาดฝั่งตะวันตกหน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อย่างน้อยก็อาจจับปลาจากบนบกได้
แล้วก็จะไม่ทำพลาดเหมือนคราวที่
แล้วด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คราวนี้ฉันจะเลี้ยงปลาดิบ
สุดหรูคุณครูให้ได้เลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
สุดท้ายก็ล้มเหลวเรื่องจะเลี้ยงปลาดิบ
สุดหรูคุณครูอีกแล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อุตส่าห์มาถึงหมู่บ้านชาวประมงทั้งที
คิดว่าจะจับปลาหายากแพงๆ
มาเลี้ยงตอบแทนคุณครูสักหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าอาหารทะเลหายากละก็
ครูกินจนอิ่มแล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็ปลิงทะเลนั่นไง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็พวกซุปสาหร่ายทะเลนั่นไง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พวกนั้นมันก็อร่อยอยู่หรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ก็เป็นอาหารทะเลที่หาได้ทั่วไป
ตามท้องตลาดนี่นา?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเทียบกับเรื่องที่คุณครูสละเวลามา
กับพวกเรา มันก็ดูธรรมดาๆ ไปเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แค่ซากิพยายามจับมาให้แบบนี้
ครูก็ถือว่าเป็นของอร่อยแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: บางครั้ง ฉันชักเริ่มไม่แน่ใจแล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ว่าที่คุณครูพูดเป็นเรื่องดีจริงๆ หรือแค่
พูดล้อเล่นกันแน่...

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你現在在做什麼？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 在休息哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 呼吸，吧……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 什麼嘛

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 意思是你什麼事都沒在做嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難得都到海邊來了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不做些只有在海邊才能做的事就太浪費了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 只有在海邊才能做的事……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 游泳之類的？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是要游泳的話，去泳池就行了吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以說……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 要去抓海產！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，現在有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我剛才找到了一個有趣的東西

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只要有這個，這次一定能抓魚給老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 是在倉庫裡找到漁網了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 哼哼

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 以為只是單純的漁網就大錯特錯了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這個還是直接給你看看比較好

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 來之前那個碼頭一趟吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這次絕對要讓老師吃到最高級的生魚片！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 後來，我又去看了看碼頭的情況

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 發現水面上漂著幾隻小魚

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 恐怕是被爆炸的衝擊震暈了吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我聽說體型小的魚意外的怕衝擊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 也就是說……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只要接入高壓電流，就能一口氣……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那個絕對不行！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，村子西邊好像有一片泥灘哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聽居民說，一天會退潮兩次

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 然後那片泥灘就會出現

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真是不可思議的現象呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聽說退潮的時候，可以很輕鬆地撿到貝類或魚

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……其實，在取得採集海產的許可時

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 他們也告訴我可以到泥灘去

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，有空的話要不要一起去？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然讓你看到了在水中的失態，不過這次只是在泥灘上撿撿魚而已。不會再犯跟上次同樣的錯誤……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這次絕對要讓老師吃到最高級的海產！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到頭來，讓老師吃到好吃海產的作戰還是失敗了啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 本來還打算抓隻高級的魚作為平時的謝禮的說……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我已經吃很多了唷？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 例如海藻湯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 或是海腸之類的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然是很好吃沒錯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過那些都是市場就能買到的食材……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 明明讓老師陪了我這麼久……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 和咲希一起吃的飯是最美味的唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 搞不清楚你是在捉弄我還是認真的，拜託饒了我吧……
